fact: The Council of Ministers communique says ANSIE met its 2022 objectives of maintaining and operating the national datacenter and developing digital services, and in 2022 launched the integrated electronic document system SIGED, a new tax-management system (SIGTAS) and the citizen services centre.
title: Travaux de la 12ième séance 12/09/2023
publisher: Présidence de la République de Djibouti
